summary: Moved planets in system 1 and 2 so every orbit is >= 2x the larger planet's diameter (4 x radius, world units after MAP_UNIT_SCALE*ORBIT_SCALE) from its neighbour; added _test_orbit_spacing; widened the T214 wake check to 6 s (ships turn 45 deg/s before moving).
note: Route distances and flight times in both systems changed (system 1 and 2 are much wider; route-based tuning is not preserved). The gap rule forces roughly 500+ data units of outer orbit. Default camera view of system 1 now shows the outer orbits partly off screen: owner decision.
